text:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated p99 latency and increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (p99 ~ 2.1s, p95 ~ 850ms). Trigger: latency-slo-service (threshold breach). Relevant canary: web-service/canary-10% deployed at 2026-03-15T18:12Z. Pager PD-3341 created.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. I'm seeing spikes across eu-west and us-west. Any recent deploys?

mike (sre): yes canary went out at 18:12. Error rate ~+7.8% 5xx, connection timeouts rising, a lot of gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED from runtime-proxy. p95 jump from 180ms -> ~850ms. p99 around 2s.

jen (prod-eng): rolled v2.3.1 patch to canary (model pipeline optimizations + new kernel selection). Only 10% traffic. I'm pulling logs now.

jen (prod-eng): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:14:17Z runtime-proxy ERROR request_id=abc123 svc=kv-cache msg="kv miss + eviction" seq_len=1024
2026-03-15T18:14:18Z model-serve WARN request_id=abc124 svc=compile msg="falling back to slow kernel" model=v2.3.1 quant=bf16
2026-03-15T18:14:19Z proxy ERROR request_id=abc125 grpc error=DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
```

jen (prod-eng): looks like for long seqs we hit a slow path in kernel selection + kv cache churn. Could be the new scheduling heuristic.

mike (sre): impact: customer-facing latencies for /generate with long prompts. Traffic profile shows a small subset of requests have seq > 512 causing tail. Customer errors: 2 enterprise customers reported timeouts via support (not yet escalated).

priya (support): Notified top-tier customers A & B via DMs and opened a bridge for customer updates. Will post short note on status page once we have mitigation.

sara (oncall): Given risk, recommend immediate rollback of canary to v2.3.0 and throttle canary to 0% while we investigate. Can someone start rollback?

jen (prod-eng): initiating rollback now. Using redwoodctl:
```
# rollback canary to previous model
redwoodctl rollout set --service web-service --deployment canary --version v2.3.0 --wait
```

deploy-bot: Rollout command received at 2026-03-15T18:27:06Z. Starting rollout: web-service/canary v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0. Canaries: scaled from 10% -> 0% in 3 steps.

mike (sre): while rollback is in progress I'm flipping a temporary routing fallback to older backend pool for long sequences: `traffic-router set-policy --service web-service --policy fallback-longseq` (this will route seq>512 to older kernels).

jen (prod-eng): rollback finished at 2026-03-15T18:32:41Z per deploy-bot. Verifying metrics...

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 2026-03-15T18:32:41Z. web-service/canary now on v2.3.0.

mike (sre): metrics stabilizing: p95 back down to ~170ms, p99 down to ~350ms, 5xx back to baseline. Confirmed error count reduced.

priya (support): Status page draft: "We detected elevated latencies for the /generate endpoint following a canary deploy. We rolled back the canary and are monitoring. No ongoing degradation as of 18:33 UTC. If you see issues, contact support." Shall I publish?

sara (oncall): publish and tag customers who reported timeouts. Also add a note to PD-3341: rollback performed, mitigated, awaiting root cause analysis.

priya (support): published at 18:36 UTC. Customers A & B updated.

jen (prod-eng): quick root-cause hypothesis: new kernel-selection path in v2.3.1 selected slow fallback for sequences >512 due to a heuristics bug; combined with increased KV cache eviction rate produced slow paths. Plan: revert the heuristic change, add canary guard for seq length, add synthetic long-seq load to canary tests.

mike (sre): action items for follow-up: 1) add long-sequence synthetic traffic to canary smoke tests, 2) increase KV cache observability (eviction metrics per deployment), 3) add a canary gating alert when p95/p99 on seq>512 increases >30%.

jen (prod-eng): I'll create a PR to revert heuristic and add tests, link it to PD-3341.

tom (oncall-night): taking over the bridge at 18:45 UTC. Handoff: rollback complete, customer updates posted, metrics stable, follow-up items tracked in PD-3341. Tag me if anything regresses.

sara (oncall): thanks — handing off. If anything spikes, page me and mike.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2026-03-15T18:40:00Z — mitigated by rollback to v2.3.0 and routing fallback. Postmortem assignment: jen (owner) due in 72h.

mike (sre): quick note — correlate request_ids abc123..abc130 for deeper trace analysis. Will attach flame graphs and kernel timing in follow-up.

jen (prod-eng): adding a canary checklist item: promote only after kv_eviction_rate < 0.5% and seq>512 latency baseline within 20% of previous version.

priya (support): closing the customer bridge; monitoring for any late reports.

tom (oncall-night): acknowledged. Handoff complete.

sara (oncall): thanks team. Filing post-incident summary in #postmortems once root cause confirmed. :white_check_mark:
